‘PONDO SA EDUKASYON, HINDI SA KORAPSYON’

Students from the University of the Philippines Baguio walk out of their classrooms on Tuesday, November 18, to protest the anomalous infrastructure projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways.

They say public funds lost to corruption could have gone to a higher budget for the education sector. 

Students from various universities in Benguet are expected to participate in the city-wide student protest a day after International Students Day. | via Joem Thayer/Rappler
